statement0:
The word "forming" is mentioned two or more times in 0.3% of neuroscience papers' Results sections, as of 2020-2024.

Among 2020-2024 papers containing "forming" , 36.7% of reported significant p-values (p < .05) are fragile (.01 ≤ p < .05) - i.e., barely fall under the standard significance threshold. This is a higher rate than the median Psychology paper (median shown for reference); relative to other words, papers with "forming" are in the top 72nd percentile of fragile p-value percentages (lower = better). Note, strong/weak p-values highly predict replicability.
statement1: As of 2020-2024, papers containing "forming" tend to be published in higher impact factor journals (85th percentile among all words) but tend to be cited less (38th percentile word). In general, this word is negatively associated with university ranking, such that higher-ranked institutions are less likely to publish papers containing "forming" (45th percentile).
